messages:
sasha_marketing: Quick sync — finalizing the launch mailwave for the benchmark report + webinar invite next Wed. Need final subject + segment rules + send windows. Who can own the send schedule?
jamie_content: I can own subject lines & preheader. will drop 3 options in ~20m. want A/B to test benchmark lead vs webinar CTA. :thinking_face:
leo_growth: I'll own segmentation and send windows. Suggest: US morning (10am ET) + APAC evening (7pm SGT) stagger. Also propose a smaller targeted re-send to non-openers at 72h.
maria_ops: For suppressions: remove anyone who opened/clicked in last 7 days; also exclude trial-converted cohort  — they get a different stream. Who has the final suppress list?
kira_design: Landing page variant ready. We have a quick hero focused on "cost & latency benchmarks" and an alternate with webinar CTA. Will share URLs.
luis_analytics: Segmentation notes: top segments by ARR and usage -> "High-engagement", "Trials last 30d", "Low-usage". Recommend primary send to High-engagement + Trials (but Trials get different copy). If we do A/B, randomize within High-engagement only.
jamie_content: Draft subjects (WIP):
```
1) New benchmark: 3x faster, 2x cheaper — see the data
2) Join our webinar: live demo + benchmark walk-through (Wed)
3) What's changed: benchmark results + product update
```
preheader options: "See how teams cut inference cost" / "Reserve your spot for Wed webinar"
sasha_marketing: Nice. Leo — can you confirm send windows and pacing? Also we need final times in the calendar invite + timezone routing rules.
leo_growth: Confirmed: primary US send Wed 10am ET, APAC stagger Thu 7pm SGT. Pace: 2k/min initial ramp, cap at 10k/hour for Dedicated recipients. Will drop exact cron in #eng-ops.
maria_ops: I'll export suppression lists and exclude file, share in Drive: link: https://drive.example.com/launch/suppressions (private). Please request access if needed.
kira_design: Landing variants: /lp/bench-hero and /lp/bench-webinar. Add UTM tag param example: ?utm_campaign=launch_benchmark_q2&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter
luis_analytics: Tracking: we'll create GTM tags and a dashboard. KPI: open rate, click-to-register, webinar RSVPs, and landing conversion (download report). Baseline open target 25% for High-engagement.
jamie_content: CTA copy for main email: "Download the benchmark" + secondary: "Reserve your spot". Short variant for Trials: "See how Redwood reduces inference cost for your team"
sasha_marketing: Assign owners: jamie -> content, leo -> sends/segmentation, maria -> suppressions/export, kira -> landing variants, luis -> tracking/dashboard. I'll own launch coordination + final approve. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Reminder: campaign scheduled window must be set in Campaign Scheduler by 18:00 PT Tue to pick up segment exports.
sasha_marketing: Final ask — subject A/B test in High-engagement only, 10k split each, holdback 5% for a delayed follow-up. If everyone ok, I'll lock copy by EOD and request campaign schedule.
jamie_content: ok locking copy at 5pm PT. i'll post final HTML and plain-text in the assets folder.
leo_growth: I'll post cron + send pace in #eng-ops and upload segment CSVs to the campaign tool by 6:30pm PT.
maria_ops: suppression export shared, invited access to folder.
kira_design: I'll upload final hero images (2 sizes) and responsive assets by 4pm PT.
luis_analytics: I'll wire up the dashboard and confirm UTM naming. expect initial dashboard in 24h.
sasha_marketing: Perfect — thanks team. Quick follow-up after first send for a short metric pulse + decide non-opener resends. :rocket:
